QikCal · Support

We’re here to help.

For help with QikCal, email hello@qik.ai. We’ll help with app features and troubleshooting.

Email QikCal support

When you write

  • Include your iPhone model, iOS version and QikCal app version.
  • Describe what you expected and what happened.
  • Please don’t email a diary export or include food, weight or health details. They aren’t needed for routine support.

Common questions

Can I search for foods offline?

Yes. QikCal searches its bundled USDA FoodData Central catalogue on your iPhone.

Why are some nutrition values unavailable?

Some reference food records do not report every nutrient. QikCal leaves missing values unavailable instead of filling them with a guess.

Where is my diary stored?

Your diary stays on your iPhone. You can export or delete it in Settings. A recap is shared only through the iOS share sheet and the destination you choose.

Where can I read about data handling?

Read the QikCal privacy policy for details about local storage, exports and sharing.
